purpose: Teach: トースト/キャンドル/めんどくさい/しわ/拾う/ガラガラ/バンバン/ローマ字

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、学食の、本気で、絶対、トースト、絶対、美味しかったよね
lines.en: The school cafeteria toast was seriously so good, wasn't it?
lines.style: Bright, energetic opening. Quick tempo, leaning into the enthusiasm of the compliment. Genuine appreciation with zero irony.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。文化祭の出し物、本気で、絶対、キャンドル、絶対、ナイト、絶対、やるんだぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. We're seriously doing the candlelit night thing for the culture festival, Sakura.
lines.style: Animated agreement. Confident forward momentum on the assertion. Slight possessive warmth in her name — he's inviting her in.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 数学の宿題、本気で、絶対、めんどくさい、絶対、なって、絶対、思っちゃうよね、リク
lines.en: Math homework is seriously such a pain, isn't it, Riku?
lines.style: Dry understatement. Quick, resigned delivery. The shared complaint of someone who knows he gets it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のシャツ、本気で、絶対、しわ、絶対、なってるぜ、桜、本気で、絶対、アイロン、絶対、当てた方がいい
lines.en: Your shirt's seriously all wrinkled, Sakura. You should actually press it.
lines.style: Casual observation wrapped in teasing concern. Matter-of-fact, like he's just noticing out loud. Not trying too hard, but checking in.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 昨日、本気で、絶対、道で、絶対、財布、絶対、拾う、絶対、人を、絶対、見かけたよ、リク
lines.en: Yesterday I actually saw someone pick up a wallet on the street, Riku.
lines.style: Reflective, surprised tone. Slight pause before 'actually,' like the memory just surfaced. Genuine curiosity about the observation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 駅前、本気で、絶対、平日、絶対、ガラガラ、絶対、なんだぜ、桜
lines.en: The station is seriously empty on weekdays, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet realization. Slow, conversational pace. The tone of someone noticing something true about the world and sharing it gently.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 運動会で、本気で、絶対、太鼓を、絶対、バンバン、絶対、叩いたよね、リク
lines.en: We were seriously going at it with the drums during the sports day, weren't we?
lines.style: Warm, bright recall. Energy builds slightly on the memory. Playful nostalgia — inviting him to remember it too.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、ローマ字入力、絶対、速いよな、桜、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: You're seriously fast at typing in Romaji, Sakura. That's actually impressive.
lines.style: Genuine, slightly embarrassed admiration. Soft delivery — not overplaying it, but sincere. A small moment of him saying something honest.
